title: GADAR: Generalizing Across Domains via Action Ranking for Classical Planning
abstract: arXiv:2610.34868v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Learned policies for classical planning act without search, but each is tied to the domain it was trained on: network modules per action schema, parameters per predicate, or vocabulary-sized encodings mean a trained policy cannot even be executed on a new domain's predicates and action schemas. We present GADAR (Generalizing Across Domains via Action Ranking), a policy that takes the domain description as input, {\pi}(s, G, D), and constructs grounded actions in domains never seen in training, without search. Symbols are described by the roles they play in the domain rather than by their names, in three layers that each extend the previous one: (i) a lifted domain layer embeds D in every state graph through structural signatures; (ii) a binding layer ties each ground action's applicability to the lifted preconditions it instantiates; and (iii) a chain layer states which schema produces what another needs and how far each schema stands fr

translated_title: GADAR：基于动作排序的经典规划跨域泛化方法
translated_abstract: 经典规划的习得策略无需搜索即可行动，但每种策略都受限于其训练所在的域：每个动作模式对应独立的网络模块、每个谓词对应独立的参数、或需要词表大小的编码，这意味着训练好的策略甚至无法在具有新谓词和动作模式的域上执行。我们提出GADAR（通过动作排序实现跨域泛化），这是一种以域描述为输入的策略 π(s, G, D)，能够在训练中从未见过的域中构造接地动作，且无需搜索。符号不再通过名称来描述，而是通过其在域中所扮演的角色来描述，分为三层，每一层都在前一层的基础上扩展：（i）提升域层通过结构签名将域描述D嵌入到每个状态图中；（ii）绑定层将每个接地动作的适用性与其实例化的提升前提条件相关联；（iii）链层描述哪个模式产生了另一个模式所需要的内容，以及每个模式距离（目标）还有多远。
tldr: GADAR提出了一种以域描述为输入的策略，通过提升域层、绑定层和链层三层机制以角色而非名称来描述符号，使经典规划策略无需搜索即可在训练中从未见过的新域中构造动作，实现跨域泛化。
en_tdlr: GADAR introduces a policy that takes the domain description as input and describes symbols by their roles rather than names through lifted-domain, binding, and chain layers, enabling searchless action construction in classical planning domains never seen during training.
